scope: VRChat SDK components from the pinned official Allowed Avatar Components list, with VRCConstraint expanded into its six concrete types. Avatar usage only; Unity components, FinalIK, Dynamic Bone and world/Udon systems are outside this inventory. Deprecated IK Follower is separate. Statuses are based on the documented release source, not a new live import test.

entries.name: Avatar Descriptor
entries.summary: Avatar root, viewpoint, eye look/blink calibration, and unified expression parameter composition.
entries.outcome: The importer identifies avatar roots, reads authored viewpoints, calibrates eye look and eyelid blinking into native AvatarEyeData, and compiles expression menus and parameters.
entries.reason: This translates viewpoint, eye look, eyelid blinking, and unified wardrobe/parameter menus. Playable layer animator state machines and custom network sync state are not fully reproduced as a VRChat runtime.

entries.name: PhysBone
entries.summary: Translated to native Resonite DynamicBoneChain with pull, stiffness, damping, and gravity forces.
entries.outcome: PhysBone hierarchies are translated into native DynamicBoneChain setups with authored motion forces.
entries.reason: Translated to native Resonite DynamicBoneChain with pull, stiffness, and gravity. Advanced PhysBone features like multi-axis stretching, grabbing, posing, and complex curve multipliers remain partial.

entries.name: PhysBone Collider
entries.summary: Translated to native DynamicBoneSphereCollider with authored position and rotation offsets.
entries.outcome: PhysBone sphere and capsule colliders are translated into native DynamicBoneSphereCollider components attached to bones.
entries.reason: Sphere colliders are mapped to native DynamicBoneSphereCollider. Plane colliders and arbitrary complex mesh shapes are not supported natively in DynamicBone.

entries.name: Contact Sender
entries.summary: Under review for native Resonite runtime equivalence; secondary to core visual mesh/dynamics transfer.
entries.outcome: The sender shape, contact tags and interaction behavior are not recreated.
entries.reason: Source objects may remain as ordinary transforms. That does not create native contact detection or matching tags.

entries.name: Contact Receiver
entries.summary: Under review for native Resonite runtime equivalence; secondary to core visual mesh/dynamics transfer.
entries.outcome: The receiver volume, detection rules and parameter response are not translated.
entries.reason: There is no native conversion of the VRChat contact-to-parameter behavior. Static appearance is not an interactive contact system.

entries.name: Aim Constraint
entries.summary: Compiled to native FrooxEngine LookAt component with cycle detection and rotation offset support.
entries.outcome: Aim constraints are translated to native LookAt components pointing towards target source slots.
entries.reason: Mapped to native FrooxEngine LookAt. Advanced aim axes, world up objects, and multi-source weighted aim blending remain limited.

entries.name: Look At Constraint
entries.summary: Compiled to native FrooxEngine LookAt component with cycle detection and rotation offset support.
entries.outcome: LookAt constraints are translated to native LookAt components orienting towards source transforms.
entries.reason: Mapped to native FrooxEngine LookAt. Multi-source weighted blending and roll limits remain limited.

entries.name: Parent Constraint
entries.summary: Compiled to native FrooxEngine CopyGlobalTransform with cycle detection and source weighting.
entries.outcome: Parent constraints are translated to native CopyGlobalTransform components maintaining position and rotation relations.
entries.reason: Mapped to native FrooxEngine CopyGlobalTransform. Multi-source weighted blending and runtime dynamic weight modulation remain limited compared to Unity's native constraint solver.

entries.name: Position Constraint
entries.summary: Compiled to native FrooxEngine CopyGlobalTransform with cycle detection and source weighting.
entries.outcome: Position constraints are translated to native CopyGlobalTransform components maintaining source position offsets.
entries.reason: Mapped to native CopyGlobalTransform. Per-axis freezing and multi-source linear blending are limited compared to Unity constraint evaluation.

entries.name: Rotation Constraint
entries.summary: Compiled to native FrooxEngine CopyGlobalTransform with cycle detection and source weighting.
entries.outcome: Rotation constraints are translated to native CopyGlobalTransform components with source orientation tracking.
entries.reason: Mapped to native CopyGlobalTransform. Multi-source rotation slerping and per-axis rotation locking remain limited.

entries.name: Scale Constraint
entries.summary: Compiled to native FrooxEngine CopyGlobalScale component with cycle detection.
entries.outcome: Scale constraints are translated to native CopyGlobalScale components mirroring non-uniform scale.
entries.reason: Mapped to native FrooxEngine CopyGlobalScale. Multi-source weighted scaling and per-axis scale freezing remain limited.

entries.name: Head Chop
entries.summary: Under review for native Resonite runtime equivalence; secondary to core visual mesh/dynamics transfer.
entries.outcome: VRChat Head Chop targets and first-person visibility settings are not translated.
entries.reason: Native avatar creation does not imply that authored SDK head-hiding rules were converted.

entries.name: Raycast
entries.summary: Under review for native Resonite runtime equivalence; secondary to core visual mesh/dynamics transfer.
entries.outcome: The SDK raycast component is not translated into native raycast behavior.
entries.reason: A retained object or bone is not a functioning raycast system.

entries.name: Spatial Audio Source
entries.summary: Under review for native Resonite runtime equivalence; secondary to core visual mesh/dynamics transfer.
entries.outcome: VRChat-specific spatial audio behavior is not translated.
entries.reason: Importing package assets is separate from recreating this SDK component and its playback or spatialization settings.

entries.name: Station
entries.summary: Under review for native Resonite runtime equivalence; secondary to core visual mesh/dynamics transfer.
entries.outcome: SDK station entry, exit and seating behavior are not recreated.
entries.reason: The station component needs a dedicated native translation; a preserved transform is not an interactive seat.

entries.name: Pipeline Manager
entries.summary: VRChat upload identity. Not a Resonite feature.
entries.outcome: VRChat blueprint and publishing identity are not carried into Resonite.
entries.reason: These identifiers belong to VRChat publishing. They do not establish a native runtime capability and are excluded from the progress total.

entries.name: IK Follower
entries.outcome: The deprecated IK Follower component is not translated.
entries.reason: The upstream avatar component list marks this component deprecated in favor of VRChat constraints. It is separate from the current collection.
